_recipe.title: Style: editorial serif
_recipe.when: Cream paper, a serif headline, one red accent: the Memoir / Conveo / Lovable research-brand look for reports, essays, research tools and premium B2B.
beats: Thesis: one sentence in serif with the key phrase in the accent.
Tension: the problem as three short dimming lines.
Evidence: one real number with its source as the kicker.
Comparison: old way vs new way.
Voice: one real quote from a customer or expert.
Close: the promise as a quiet link; logo.
copyTips: Measured on 8 editorial references: 5 of 8 are light (cream / off-white) and 0 of 8 are dark. Keep the paper warm, never pure white.
Exactly one accent colour, a warm red or orange around #DE351F, used for one phrase per scene.
Serif for statements, sans for labels and numbers. Tiny tracked labels (kicker plain) carry the structure.
Every number needs a source in the kicker ("Survey of 2,000 teams, 2026").
Calm motion and fades: the references cut rarely and let lines appear word by word.

scenes.say: The old way: [OLD WAY]. With [BRAND]: [NEW WAY].
